subject: Intro + quick qualification for Redwood trial demo
messages:
From: Eli Howard <eli.howard@seedling.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trying Redwood trial — interested in a short walkthrough

Hi Grace,

We signed up for the Redwood self-serve trial this morning (account: Seedling AI) and I wanted to see whether someone could do a quick 20–30 minute walkthrough. We primarily care about inference latency, cost per 1k tokens, and how easy it is to route requests to different model variants.

Very high level:
- Use case: customer support automation + ticket summarization
- Expected volume: starting ~250k tokens/month, could ramp to ~2M in 3–6 months
- Timeline: PoC in next 3–6 weeks if fit

Can you put me on the calendar? If you want any details before booking, tell me what you need.

Best,
Eli
Eli Howard
Head of Platform
Seedling AI
eli.howard@seedling.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Howard <eli.howard@seedling.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trying Redwood trial — interested in a short walkthrough

Thanks for signing up, Eli — welcome!

Quick note: I work on limited SDR hours today but I can do a quick qualification now so we scope the walkthrough properly. A couple of short clarifying Qs (one-liners are perfect):
1) Which channels will you be using (chat widget, email automation, API back-end)?
2) Is the 250k tokens/month estimate for production traffic or an initial test environment?
3) Any compliance needs (PII sensitive, SOC2/contractual controls) we should flag up front?
4) Who else from Seedling should join the demo? (names + roles)

If that's all fine, here are three 30-minute slots in PT this week — pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite:
- Thu Jun 10, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu Jun 10, 14:00–14:30 PT
- Fri Jun 11, 09:30–10:00 PT

If none of those work, I can share a Calendly link and Ben (our solutions rep) can join next week for a deeper walkthrough.

Also, if you'd like, I can attach a one-pager that outlines typical latency/cost tradeoffs for small-to-medium support workloads.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
From: Eli Howard <eli.howard@seedling.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@seedling.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trying Redwood trial — interested in a short walkthrough

Great — quick answers below:
1) Channels: mostly API back-end powering our reply-suggestion service; small chat widget pilot later.
2) 250k tokens/month is our expected production first-month run for the pilot environment; hope to reach ~1.5–2M by Q4 if all goes well.
3) Compliance: some PII in tickets — we need to understand data retention defaults and whether we can route requests through a private deployment later. SOC2 is a potential ask.
4) Joining: Maya Singh (Engineering Lead) + me.

The Thu Jun 10 14:00–14:30 PT slot works best for us. If Ben wants to join, that'd be helpful but not required.

Thanks,
Eli
